quizQuestions.question_text: Which table in SAP S/4HANA serves as the Universal Journal containing both FI and CO line items?
quizQuestions.explanation: ACDOCA is the Universal Journal table in SAP S/4HANA unifying general ledger, asset accounting, controlling, and profitability analysis.

quizQuestions.question_text: Is Business Partner (BP) mandatory for creating Customers and Vendors in SAP S/4HANA?
quizQuestions.explanation: Yes, in S/4HANA, traditional transactions like XD01 and XK01 redirect to transaction BP (Business Partner).

doubts.title: Error F5151: Company code 1000 is not defined in transaction FB50
doubts.description: When I try to post a GL document in FB50 for company code 1000, the system displays error F5151 saying company code is not fully defined. I completed OX02 and OX16.

messages.message: When I try to post a GL document in FB50 for company code 1000, the system displays error F5151 saying company code is not fully defined. I completed OX02 and OX16.

Hi Amit, please check transaction OBY6 (Company Code Global Parameters) to ensure the fiscal year variant (e.g. V3) and chart of accounts (INT) are assigned to company code 1000. Also verify OB52 for open posting periods.
